hints.title: Level Sum Accumulation
hints.text: Traverse the tree level by level and calculate the total node value sum at each depth.

hints.title: Level Count Check
hints.text: If the tree contains fewer than k levels, return -1 as the kth largest cannot exist.

hints.title: Sorting Level Aggregates
hints.text: Collect all level sums into an array and sort them in descending order to locate the element at index k - 1.

hints.title: Level-Order Sum Extraction Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: BFS explores n nodes once; sorting h level sums takes O(h log h).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: DFS without grouping level sums requires extra mapping structures.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) space for BFS traversal queue.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Extracts level sums using standard BFS level order and checks k <= level count.
